description: A chemical company uses two tests, a salinity test and a pH test. Each unit of the salinity test requires three probes. Whereas each unit of the pH test requires two probes. The chemical company must perform at least 250 pH tests. In total, at least 400 tests must be performed. Further, because of the importance of the salinity test, there must be at most 1.5 times more pH tests than salinity tests. How many times should each test be performed to minimize the total number of probes used?

MinPHTests.definition: Minimum number of pH tests to be performed

MinTotalTests.definition: Minimum total number of tests to be performed

MaxPHtoSalinityRatio.definition: Maximum ratio of number of pH tests to salinity tests

objective.description: Minimize the total number of probes used to perform the salinity and pH tests

constraints.description: Number of pH tests performed must be at least MinPHTests
Total number of tests performed (pH tests plus salinity tests) must be at least MinTotalTests
Number of pH tests performed must be less than or equal to MaxPHtoSalinityRatio times the number of salinity tests performed
